poc_notes: Hosted POC: 2-week run; sample: 200k monthly queries, mix chat (60%) + semantic search (25%) + reranking (15%).
Observed: median p50 latency 120ms for chat on hosted, 95th at 420ms during spikes — acceptable for UI but cost per 1M tokens unsustainable at projected scale.
Dedicated benchmark: baseline config 2 reserved A100-equivalent GPUs -> sustained throughput improvement ~4x vs hosted baseline; predictable tail latency under 200ms.
Key ask: predictable monthly bill with ability to burst up to 6 GPUs for product launches; prefer monthly ramp schedule vs immediate full commit.
pricing_negotiation_notes: Silverpine prefers: 12-month commit starting at 2 reserved GPUs with optional monthly ramp to 4 GPUs by month 4 and ability to burst to 6 GPUs for up to 200 GPU-hours/month.
They asked for overage cap: negotiate blended overage rate not exceeding 1.5x committed unit price.
Discount asks: 12-month vs 36-month tiered discounts (10% @12mo, 18% @36mo) and lower per-GPU-month with annual upfront payment.
Requested SLOs: 99.9% availability and median token latency guidance; credit schedule requested in draft SOW.
Finance quote: needs line-item showing committed GPU-months, burst pool, overage calc, and estimated ARR impact for FY26.
commercial_terms_discussed: Commit levels: 2 / 4 / 8 GPU-month bands considered; preference for starting small and ramping.
Bursting: technical burst (auto-scale) vs reserved burst pool; Silverpine prefers reserved burst pool with predictable billing for planning.
Ramp schedule: Month1=2 GPUs, Month4=4 GPUs, Month7=6 GPUs (optional) to match product launch cadence.
Overage: proposed 1.5x committed unit rate; AE proposed graduated overage (first 50 GPU-hours at 1.25x, thereafter 1.5x).
Termination / downsizing: 60-day notice for scaling down committed tier at renewal; proration rules to be included in pricing addendum.

Compliance: retention controls and audit logging must be exposed via Console; Silverpine needs 1-year access to audit logs for compliance with internal policy.
